findings.pod_summary: Two policy-matched passes took 237.7/239.0s versus 341.5/375.0s for two serial controls (about 30–36% less process time). The case envelope fell from 232.6/240.6s to 156.6/155.8s: 76–85s, or 33–35%, of observed case-wall reduction. All 13 scenarios passed, with storage exclusive and at most two active case scopes. CPU was 580–587s versus 714–799s. Shared setup was also faster (61–62s versus 68–98s), so the entire process delta is not attributed to concurrency. Controls and candidates stayed on different recycled workers; cache and host effects remain confounded, and this is a small experiment rather than a fleet estimate.
findings.vm_summary: Both four-guest passes preserved the asserted checks, but took 571.9/448.8s versus 395.7/360.0s for six-guest controls. Case envelopes also grew to 290.4/300.7s from 198.1/226.5s. Successful CPU was 2463/1804s versus 2011/1787s; observed peak memory fell to 7.1–7.2GB from 9.8–10.2GB. Thus there is no demonstrated latency or CPU win. Both controls used one recycled worker and both successful candidates another, so this does not isolate a code regression. Trial 1 additionally lost a 221.1s physical attempt to an outer-worker kernel panic; full invocation was 801.0s. Keep the prototype, but require worker-controlled validation before adoption for speed.
findings.gate_summary: No matched full-gate saving was measured. In the representative integration run, VM was last and Pod finished 46s earlier; accelerating Pod alone would not shorten that observed gate. The hosted MCP split still took about 301–304s in its colder run and may become the next floor if VM improves. Reaching twice-as-fast feedback requires reducing the remaining VM path and cold setup across selected suites, then measuring the complete required checks together.
limits: Workers were recycled and not reserved or randomized between variants.
Fresh TestRunner results do not imply cold image stores or cold build caches.
The second Pod invocation spent about31s outside its successful test process, including analysis; this is retained in full-invocation data.
No production CI selection was edited; the candidates are manual targets.
findings.pod_headline: Two-slot Pod runs passed all 13 scenarios in 238–239s versus 342–375s for serial controls; the case envelope was 33–35% shorter. This is a promising suite improvement, with worker/cache confounding and full-gate impact still unmeasured.
findings.vm_headline: Four-guest VM consolidation passed its retained checks, but both runs were slower than controls. Observed peak memory was lower; a latency or CPU saving remains unproved.

+# VM consolidation spike
+
+This manual target keeps `//agentplane/system_tests/suites:test_vm` unchanged as its control. It folds the VM mTLS scenario into each existing shell turn, reducing the concurrent guest count from six to four. The stack, guest images, 8-unit executor request, timeout, OOM recovery, sampler, shutdown checks, and process-trace contract stay the same.
+
+Run with a fresh remote test action:
+
+```bash
+bbr test //agentplane/system_tests/suites/x/vm_consolidation:test_vm_consolidated --nocache_test_results
+```
+
+The candidate uses the same certificate, launcher identity, command-admission, retained-history, and Thread-fold checks as `runner_credentials.vm_mtls_certificate_authenticates_a_session`. They run on the existing supervised Session, immediately around its existing shell turn. The setup supervision check and shell UID, PID 1, cgroup, and systemd-denial assertions remain enabled.
+
+The Claude mTLS check moves from `runner-vm` to `runner-vm-supervision`. The fixture constructs that template by copying the ordinary VM template and adding only the supervisor-check kernel argument; both use the same guest root. Certificate generation and launcher identity are independent of that guest argument, but the candidate no longer measures Claude mTLS on the ordinary template itself. Codex remains on `runner-vm`.
+
+This target is under `suites/x` so it can depend on the scenario libraries. The spike adds subpackage visibility for the existing VM process-trace contract; its assertions remain enabled.

--- /dev/null
+++ b/agentplane/system_tests/suites/x/vm_consolidation/test_vm_consolidated.py
@@ -0,0 +1,212 @@
+"""Manual VM consolidation spike; the ordinary test_vm target is the control."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import asyncio
+import os
+import re
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+from uuid import uuid4
+
+import pytest
+import pytest_bazel
+from tenacity import AsyncRetrying, retry_if_result, stop_after_delay, wait_fixed
+
+from agentplane.app.testing.client import REQUEST_SECONDS, Client
+from agentplane.app.testing.models import ThreadView
+from agentplane.proto import command_pb2, event_log_pb2, event_pb2, runner_pb2
+from agentplane.runner_gateway.dispatcher import session_dispatcher_pb2
+from agentplane.system_tests.agent import Agent, Turn
+from agentplane.system_tests.cluster import Cluster
+from agentplane.system_tests.executor import Executor
+from agentplane.system_tests.k3s.guest_logs import check_boot, systemd_supervision_passed
+from agentplane.system_tests.k3s.vm_trace_contract import assert_vm_process_trace_contract
+from agentplane.system_tests.offered_models import models_offered_for
+from agentplane.system_tests.sandbox import VM_TEMPLATE, Sandboxes
+from agentplane.system_tests.scenario import ScenarioResources
+from agentplane.system_tests.scenarios import central_sampler, runner_credentials, vm_sandbox
+from agentplane.system_tests.scripted_upstream import ScriptedUpstream
+from agentplane.system_tests.tracing import traced_scenario, tracer
+from agentplane.system_tests.vm_configuration import SUPERVISION_TEMPLATE
+from agentplane.system_tests.vm_supervision import session_setup_is_supervised
+from agentplane.testing.scripted_model import ShellCall, Text
+from util.testing.undeclared_outputs import undeclared_outputs_dir
+
+# runner_pb2.pyi imports protobuf stubs directly during mypy's dependency traversal.
+# gazelle:include_dep @pypi//protobuf
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.vm_sandboxes
+
+
+async def _wait_for_vm_process_trace_contract() -> None:
+    output_dir = undeclared_outputs_dir()
+    loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
+    deadline = loop.time() + 30
+    artifacts = [output_dir / "test-spans.jsonl", output_dir / "process-spans.jsonl"]
+    last_sizes: tuple[int, ...] = ()
+    error: AssertionError | None = None
+    while True:
+        current_sizes = tuple(path.stat().st_size if path.exists() else 0 for path in artifacts)
+        if current_sizes != last_sizes:
+            try:
+                assert_vm_process_trace_contract(output_dir)
+            except AssertionError as caught:
+                error = caught
+            else:
+                return
+            last_sizes = current_sizes
+        if loop.time() >= deadline:
+            raise AssertionError(f"VM process trace contract failed: {error}") from error
+        await asyncio.sleep(0.5)
+
+
+async def _credential_shell_turn(
+    client: Client, agent: Agent, model: Any, *, command_id: str, prompt: str, shell_command: str
+) -> tuple[Turn, Any]:
+    async with asyncio.TaskGroup() as turns:
+        collecting = turns.create_task(agent.next_turn(awaiting_command_id=command_id))
+        command = command_pb2.Command(command_id=command_id, submit_input=command_pb2.SubmitInput(text=prompt))
+        admission = await client.submit_input(agent.thread_id, command_id, prompt)
+        if isinstance(admission, session_dispatcher_pb2.Dispatch):
+            assert admission.command_id == command_id
+            assert admission.operation == session_dispatcher_pb2.OPERATION_SUBMIT_INPUT
+        else:
+            assert isinstance(admission, event_log_pb2.EventEntry)
+            assert admission.event.command_admitted.command == command
+
+        request = await model.request()
+        assert prompt in request.user_texts
+        call_id = "vm-supervision"
+        await model.reply(request, ShellCall(call_id=call_id, command=shell_command))
+        result = await model.request()
+        try:
+            (output,) = result.tool_outputs
+            assert output.call_id == call_id
+            assert output.contains("VM_MTLS_OK")
+        finally:
+            # Complete the scripted turn even when a shell assertion fails, so teardown sees its verdict.
+            await model.reply(result, Text("PING"))
+
+    turn = collecting.result()
+    assert turn.status == event_pb2.TURN_STATUS_COMPLETED
+    entries = await runner_credentials._history(client, agent.thread_id, completed_turns=1)
+    assert any(
+        entry.event.HasField("command_admitted") and entry.event.command_admitted.command.command_id == command_id
+        for entry in entries
+    ), f"History did not retain command admission {command_id}"
+    view: ThreadView = await AsyncRetrying(
+        stop=stop_after_delay(REQUEST_SECONDS),
+        wait=wait_fixed(0.05),
+        retry=retry_if_result(lambda row: row.last_cursor < entries[-1].cursor),
+    )(client.thread, agent.thread_id)
+    assert view.last_turn_status == "TURN_STATUS_COMPLETED"
+    return turn, output
+
+
+async def _vm_turn_with_credentials(
+    cluster: Cluster,
+    client: Client,
+    sandbox: Sandboxes,
+    harness: runner_pb2.Harness,
+    offered_model: str,
+    scripted: ScriptedUpstream,
+    template: str,
+) -> None:
+    view = await sandbox(f"systest-vm-{harness}", template=template)
+    assert view.pod is not None
+    old_pod_uid, credential_id = await runner_credentials._identity(cluster, view.pod.name)
+    await runner_credentials._ready_certificate(
+        cluster, f"runner-{credential_id}", view.name, str(view.uid), credential_id, view.namespace
+    )
+
+    if template == SUPERVISION_TEMPLATE:
+        async for attempt in AsyncRetrying(stop=stop_after_delay(10), wait=wait_fixed(0.1), reraise=True):
+            with attempt:
+                check_boot()
+                assert systemd_supervision_passed(view.pod.uid), "Missing this VM's supervisor check receipt"
+
+    model = scripted.model(view.pod.name, harness)
+    with tracer.start_as_current_span(
+        "system_test.session.open", attributes={"harness": runner_pb2.Harness.Name(harness), "sandbox.name": view.name}
+    ):
+        agent = await session_setup_is_supervised(client, view.name, view.uid, harness, offered_model)
+    shell_command = f"{vm_sandbox.VM_SUPERVISION_PROBE}\nprintf 'VM_MTLS_OK\\n'\n"
+    with tracer.start_as_current_span("system_test.turn"):
+        turn, output = await _credential_shell_turn(
+            client,
+            agent,
+            model,
+            command_id=f"vm-{uuid4().hex}",
+            prompt="Run a shell check in the VM runner.",
+            shell_command=shell_command,
+        )
+
+    assert output.contains("VM_UID 107"), output.blocks
+    assert output.contains("VM_PID1 systemd"), output.blocks
+    output_text = "\n".join(output.blocks)
+    (cgroup_line,) = [line for line in output_text.splitlines() if line.startswith("VM_CGROUP ")]
+    cgroup = cgroup_line.removeprefix("VM_CGROUP ")
+    subtree = "agentplane-executors.slice" if harness == runner_pb2.HARNESS_CODEX else "agentplane-workloads.slice"
+    vm_sandbox._assert_native_service_cgroup(cgroup, subtree)
+    assert "VM_SYSTEMCTL_UNEXPECTED_SUCCESS" not in output_text, output.blocks
+    assert re.search(r"authentication|authorization|not authorized|access denied", output_text, re.IGNORECASE), (
+        output.blocks
+    )
+    assert "PING" in turn.answer, turn.transcript
+
+    current_pod_uid, current_credential_id = await runner_credentials._identity(cluster, view.pod.name)
+    assert (current_pod_uid, current_credential_id) == (old_pod_uid, credential_id)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.vm_sandboxes
+@pytest.mark.scripted_model
+@pytest.mark.timeout(600)
+async def test_vm_scenarios(
+    cluster: Cluster, tmp_path: Path, client: Client, scenario_resources: ScenarioResources, scripted: ScriptedUpstream
+) -> None:
+    harnesses = [runner_pb2.HARNESS_CLAUDE, runner_pb2.HARNESS_CODEX]
+    models = await models_offered_for(client, harnesses)
+
+    async def turn(harness: runner_pb2.Harness, template: str) -> None:
+        async with scenario_resources() as (owned_client, sandbox):
+            await _vm_turn_with_credentials(
+                cluster, owned_client, sandbox, harness, models[harness], scripted, template
+            )
+
+    async def oom() -> None:
+        async with scenario_resources() as (owned_client, sandbox):
+            await vm_sandbox.codex_tool_oom(
+                cluster,
+                owned_client,
+                sandbox,
+                models[runner_pb2.HARNESS_CODEX],
+                scripted,
+                native_profile=os.environ.get("AGENTPLANE_VM_NATIVE_PROFILE") == "1",
+            )
+
+    # Each task owns its guests and cleanup; sampler setup has a separate ownership scope.
+    async with asyncio.TaskGroup() as scenarios:
+        scenarios.create_task(
+            traced_scenario(
+                "central-sampler",
+                central_sampler.dispatcher_central_setup_tool_and_retained_answer(
+                    cluster,
+                    tmp_path,
+                    scripted,
+                    Executor(template="runner-vm", cwd="/state/workspaces/accept"),
+                    central_sampler.VM_EXECUTION,
+                ),
+            )
+        )
+        scenarios.create_task(
+            traced_scenario("vm-turn-harness_claude", turn(runner_pb2.HARNESS_CLAUDE, SUPERVISION_TEMPLATE))
+        )
+        scenarios.create_task(traced_scenario("vm-turn-harness_codex", turn(runner_pb2.HARNESS_CODEX, VM_TEMPLATE)))
+        scenarios.create_task(traced_scenario("codex-tool-oom", oom()))
+
+    await _wait_for_vm_process_trace_contract()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    pytest_bazel.main()

+"""Manual bounded-Pod-case concurrency spike; not included in normal CI selection.
+
+Scenarios that use a client or Sandbox manager get their own, including cleanup; native diagnostic
+capture matches the ordinary Pod suite's policy. Scripted model queues are isolated by Pod on one
+suite-owned server. Claude and Codex remain concurrent inside scenarios that already use
+``run_harness_pair``. The
+storage scenario runs alone because it requires an empty Sandbox inventory and changes shared
+storage configuration; the other cases run with at most two active scenario scopes.
+
+Pytest sees one aggregate item, so the per-case result artifact and scenario spans carry identities
+that separate JUnit would otherwise provide. This is an experiment, not a reusable scenario runner.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import asyncio
+import json
+from collections.abc import AsyncIterator, Awaitable, Callable
+from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
+from contextvars import ContextVar
+from functools import partial
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+import httpx
+import pytest
+import pytest_bazel
+from opentelemetry import trace
+from opentelemetry.trace import Status, StatusCode
+
+from agentplane.proto import runner_pb2
+from agentplane.system_tests.agent import TURN_SECONDS
+from agentplane.system_tests.cluster import Cluster
+from agentplane.system_tests.executor import Executor
+from agentplane.system_tests.harness_pair import run_harness_pair
+from agentplane.system_tests.scenario import ScenarioResources, open_resources
+from agentplane.system_tests.scenarios import (
+    agent_messaging,
+    egress,
+    launch_presets,
+    runner_credentials,
+    session_instructions,
+    storage,
+    suspend_resume,
+    thread_stream,
+)
+from agentplane.system_tests.scripted_upstream import ScriptedUpstream
+from agentplane.testing.scripted_model import ScriptedModel
+from util.net import Listener
+from util.testing.undeclared_outputs import undeclared_outputs_dir
+
+# runner_pb2.pyi imports protobuf stubs directly during mypy's dependency traversal.
+# gazelle:include_dep @pypi//protobuf
+
+
+class CaseTrackingScriptedUpstream(ScriptedUpstream):
+    """The real scripted server with a ContextVar scope for each owning scenario."""
+
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self._case_pods: ContextVar[set[str] | None] = ContextVar("pod_case_pods", default=None)
+
+    @asynccontextmanager
+    async def case_scope(self) -> AsyncIterator[set[str]]:
+        pods: set[str] = set()
+        token = self._case_pods.set(pods)
+        try:
+            yield pods
+        finally:
+            self._case_pods.reset(token)
+
+    def model(self, pod: str, harness: runner_pb2.Harness) -> ScriptedModel[Any]:
+        if (pods := self._case_pods.get()) is None:
+            raise RuntimeError("scripted model requested outside a Pod scenario scope")
+        pods.add(pod)
+        return super().model(pod, harness)
+
+    def assert_settled(self, pods: set[str]) -> None:
+        """Fail this case as soon as one of its Pods leaves an unanswered model request."""
+        unsettled: list[str] = []
+        for pod in sorted(pods):
+            for dialect, endpoints in (("claude", self._messages), ("codex", self._responses)):
+                endpoint = endpoints.get(pod)
+                if endpoint is not None:
+                    count = sum(exchange._settled_by is None for exchange in endpoint._exchanges)
+                    if count:
+                        unsettled.append(f"{pod}/{dialect}: {count}")
+        assert not unsettled, f"case left unanswered scripted model requests: {', '.join(unsettled)}"
+
+
+Case = Callable[[ScriptedUpstream], Awaitable[None]]
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+async def scripted_server(scripted_listener: Listener) -> AsyncIterator[CaseTrackingScriptedUpstream]:
+    """One ingress endpoint routes requests by their verified Pod identity across active cases."""
+    server = CaseTrackingScriptedUpstream()
+    async with server.serving(listener=scripted_listener.socket):
+        yield server
+
+
+@asynccontextmanager
+async def _http(base_url: str, token: str) -> AsyncIterator[httpx.AsyncClient]:
+    """A case-owned browser client for raw HTTP and Server-Sent Events checks."""
+    async with httpx.AsyncClient(
+        base_url=base_url.rstrip("/"),
+        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"},
+        timeout=httpx.Timeout(thread_stream.REQUEST_SECONDS, read=TURN_SECONDS),
+    ) as opened:
+        yield opened
+
+
+def _cases(
+    *,
+    cluster: Cluster,
+    scenario_resources: ScenarioResources,
+    base_url: str,
+    token: str,
+    scripted_server: CaseTrackingScriptedUpstream,
+) -> list[tuple[str, Case]]:
+    case_resources = scenario_resources
+
+    async def messaging(scripted: ScriptedUpstream) -> None:
+        async with case_resources() as (client, sandboxes):
+            await run_harness_pair(
+                client,
+                lambda harness, model: agent_messaging.an_agent_messages_another_which_reads_and_acknowledges_it(
+                    cluster, client, sandboxes, harness, model, scripted
+                ),
+            )
+
+    async def late_policy(scripted: ScriptedUpstream) -> None:
+        async with case_resources() as (client, sandboxes):
+            await run_harness_pair(
+                client,
+                lambda harness, model: egress.a_policy_granted_after_the_sandbox_is_running_takes_effect(
+                    cluster, client, sandboxes, harness, model, scripted
+                ),
+            )
+
+    async def model_proxy(scripted: ScriptedUpstream) -> None:
+        async with case_resources() as (client, sandboxes):
+            await run_harness_pair(
+                client,
+                lambda harness, model: egress.the_model_call_itself_goes_through_the_proxy(
+                    cluster, client, sandboxes, harness, model, scripted
+                ),
+            )
+
+    async def launch_preset(scripted: ScriptedUpstream) -> None:
+        async with case_resources() as (client, sandboxes):
+            await launch_presets.a_preset_launches_an_initialized_editable_codex_thread(client, sandboxes, scripted)
+
+    async def cert_reissue(_: ScriptedUpstream) -> None:
+        await runner_credentials.cert_manager_reissues_a_deleted_tls_secret(cluster)
+
+    async def pod_mtls(scripted: ScriptedUpstream) -> None:
+        async with case_resources() as (client, sandboxes):
+            async with asyncio.timeout(600):
+                await run_harness_pair(
+                    client,
+                    lambda harness, model: runner_credentials.pod_mtls_session_survives_replacement_and_keeps_history(
+                        cluster, client, sandboxes, harness, model, scripted
+                    ),
+                )
+
+    async def standing_instruction(scripted: ScriptedUpstream) -> None:
+        async with case_resources() as (client, sandboxes):
+            await run_harness_pair(
+                client,
+                lambda harness, model: (
+                    session_instructions.the_standing_instruction_reaches_the_model_and_only_in_its_own_session(
+                        client, sandboxes, harness, model, scripted
+                    )
+                ),
+            )
+
+    async def workspace_storage(_: ScriptedUpstream) -> None:
+        async with case_resources() as (client, _sandboxes):
+            await storage.fresh_workspace_storage_survives_replacement(
+                cluster, client, Executor(template="runner", cwd="/state/work"), storage.StorageLayout.POD_DIRECTORY
+            )
+
+    async def codex_suspend_resume(scripted: ScriptedUpstream) -> None:
+        async with case_resources() as (client, sandboxes):
+            await suspend_resume.codex_standing_instructions_after_suspend_and_compact(
+                cluster, client, sandboxes, scripted
+            )
+
+    async def thread_context_suspend_resume(scripted: ScriptedUpstream) -> None:
+        async with case_resources() as (client, sandboxes):
+            await suspend_resume.two_harness_threads_keep_their_context_after_sandbox_suspend_resume(
+                cluster, client, sandboxes, scripted, Executor(template="runner", cwd="/state/work")
+            )
+
+    async def unknown_thread(_: ScriptedUpstream) -> None:
+        async with _http(base_url, token) as http:
+            await thread_stream.an_unknown_thread_is_not_found(http)
+
+    async def tab_streams(scripted: ScriptedUpstream) -> None:
+        async with case_resources() as (client, sandboxes), _http(base_url, token) as http:
+            await run_harness_pair(
+                client,
+                lambda harness, model: (
+                    thread_stream.every_tab_follows_one_log_and_a_reconnect_resumes_after_its_last_event(
+                        client, http, sandboxes, harness, model, scripted
+                    )
+                ),
+            )
+
+    async def unwatched_turns(scripted: ScriptedUpstream) -> None:
+        async with case_resources() as (client, sandboxes), _http(base_url, token) as http:
+            await run_harness_pair(
+                client,
+                lambda harness, model: (
+                    thread_stream.turns_nobody_watches_are_archived_and_a_failed_one_leaves_the_next_input_its_own_turn(
+                        client, http, sandboxes, harness, model, scripted
+                    )
+                ),
+            )
+
+    return [
+        ("agent_messaging", messaging),
+        ("policy_granted_after_start", late_policy),
+        ("model_proxy", model_proxy),
+        ("launch_preset", launch_preset),
+        ("certificate_reissue", cert_reissue),
+        ("pod_mtls_replacement", pod_mtls),
+        ("standing_instruction", standing_instruction),
+        ("workspace_storage", workspace_storage),
+        ("codex_suspend_resume", codex_suspend_resume),
+        ("two_harness_context_resume", thread_context_suspend_resume),
+        ("unknown_thread_http", unknown_thread),
+        ("thread_tab_streams", tab_streams),
+        ("unwatched_turn_archive", unwatched_turns),
+    ]
+
+
+def _write_results(path: Path, document: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    temporary = path.with_suffix(".tmp")
+    temporary.write_text(json.dumps(document, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
+    temporary.replace(path)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.scripted_model
+async def test_pod_scenarios_with_two_case_slots(
+    cluster: Cluster,
+    base_url: str,
+    token: str,
+    scripted_server: CaseTrackingScriptedUpstream,
+    phase_tracer: trace.Tracer,
+) -> None:
+    case_resources: ScenarioResources = partial(
+        open_resources, cluster, base_url, token, phase_tracer, native_diagnostics=False
+    )
+    cases = _cases(
+        cluster=cluster,
+        scenario_resources=case_resources,
+        base_url=base_url,
+        token=token,
+        scripted_server=scripted_server,
+    )
+    storage_name = "workspace_storage"
+    results: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {name: {"status": "pending"} for name, _ in cases}
+    document: dict[str, Any] = {
+        "status": "running",
+        "case_concurrency_limit": 2,
+        "exclusive_cases": [storage_name],
+        "pytest_reporting": "one aggregate pytest item; see per-case records and spans",
+        "cases": results,
+    }
+    output = undeclared_outputs_dir() / "pod_case_results.json"
+    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    _write_results(output, document)
+
+    failures: dict[str, Exception] = {}
+    active = 0
+    peak_active = 0
+
+    async def run_case(name: str, scenario_case: Case) -> None:
+        nonlocal active, peak_active
+        active += 1
+        peak_active = max(peak_active, active)
+        results[name] = {"status": "running", "scripted_model_pods": []}
+        _write_results(output, document)
+        error: Exception | None = None
+        with phase_tracer.start_as_current_span(
+            "system_test.scenario",
+            attributes={"scenario": name, "case_concurrency_limit": 2},
+            record_exception=False,
+            set_status_on_exception=False,
+        ) as span:
+            async with scripted_server.case_scope() as pods:
+                try:
+                    await scenario_case(scripted_server)
+                except Exception as caught:
+                    error = caught
+                    span.set_status(Status(StatusCode.ERROR, str(caught)))
+                try:
+                    scripted_server.assert_settled(pods)
+                except Exception as caught:
+                    if error is None:
+                        error = caught
+                    else:
+                        error.add_note(f"scripted model settlement check also failed: {caught!r}")
+                    span.set_status(Status(StatusCode.ERROR, str(caught)))
+        active -= 1
+        record: dict[str, Any] = {
+            "status": "failed" if error is not None else "passed",
+            "scripted_model_pods": sorted(pods),
+        }
+        if error is not None:
+            error.add_note(f"pod_case={name}")
+            record["error"] = f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}"
+            failures[name] = error
+        results[name] = record
+        document["peak_active_cases"] = peak_active
+        _write_results(output, document)
+
+    # This case requires the inventory to be empty and changes shared storage configuration.
+    await run_case(storage_name, dict(cases)[storage_name])
+    if storage_name in failures:
+        for name in results:
+            if results[name]["status"] == "pending":
+                results[name] = {"status": "not_run", "reason": "the exclusive storage case failed"}
+        document["status"] = "failed"
+        _write_results(output, document)
+        raise ExceptionGroup("exclusive storage case failed", [failures[storage_name]])
+
+    limit = asyncio.Semaphore(2)
+
+    async def bounded(name: str, scenario_case: Case) -> None:
+        async with limit:
+            await run_case(name, scenario_case)
+
+    async with asyncio.TaskGroup() as tasks:
+        for name, scenario_case in cases:
+            if name != storage_name:
+                tasks.create_task(bounded(name, scenario_case), name=name)
+
+    document["status"] = "failed" if failures else "passed"
+    document["peak_active_cases"] = peak_active
+    _write_results(output, document)
+    if failures:
+        raise ExceptionGroup("Pod scenario failures", list(failures.values()))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    pytest_bazel.main()
